problem:
Let $a=⟨1,-2,3⟩$ and $b=⟨1,-1,-1⟩.$ Find the vector projection of $a$ onto $b.$

${\text{proj}}_{b}\,a=⟨$

{{field-1}},

{{field-2}},

{{field-3}}

$⟩$
worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{a\cdot b}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 1+(-2)\cdot (-1)+3\cdot (-1)}{{1}^{2}+(-1)^{2}+(-1)^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{0}{3}b \\  & =⟨0,0,0⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
